item.title: SKADI 1.0.0-beta.21
item.description:
SKADI 1.0.0-beta.21 — One release for every platform

This is the first beta built and published by the coordinated release factory for every platform from one tag: Windows, Linux, LG webOS and the Android TV beta APK on GitHub, plus the Fire OS APK for Amazon Live App Testing. It is also the first public desktop release since beta.17.

Main changes

  • Background trailers are now off by default on Android TV / Fire OS and webOS. Turn them on in Settings (Background trailers, then Trailer sound). A choice already saved on a device or a SKADI profile is kept.
  • New downloads: SKADI-1.0.0-beta.21-webos.ipk (LG webOS, Developer Mode / sideload) and SKADI-1.0.0-beta.21-android-tv-beta.apk (Android TV sideload, installs as "SKADI Beta" next to the store build).

Since the last public release (beta.17)

  • Search: accent- and typo-tolerant ranking on every platform, search home with recent searches per profile.
  • Server trailers (Plex, Jellyfin, Emby): Trailer action on the details page, optional muted preview behind the TV hero.
  • Android TV / Fire OS playback: refresh-rate matching in three modes, next episode and track changes in the same player window, audio boost, adaptive normalization and dialogue enhancement after PCM decoding.
  • webOS: sleep timer, Next episode at the top of the player settings, closed-beta features (English, themes, movie/show pages, Watchlist, Collections, Playlists, every Plex server of the account, opt-in Sentry reports).
  • Jellyfin / Emby sign-in: a public address typed without a scheme is tried over HTTPS, and the password is never sent over plain HTTP without an explicit http://.
  • Full details in CHANGELOG.md (beta.18 to beta.21).

Version and distribution

  • Product version 1.0.0-beta.21, build 55; webOS package version 1.0.55.
  • Android versionCode 55, strictly greater than beta.20 (54) on the Live App Testing track. Identifier com.skadi.client and release signing unchanged.
  • GitHub release (arthoriouss/skadi-releases): Windows installer and portable ZIP, Linux .deb, .tar.gz, .rpm and Flatpak, webOS IPK, Android TV beta APK, release-index.json and SHA256SUMS.txt. Windows updates through WinSparkle (appcast.xml).
  • Fire OS: private Actions artifact skadi-fireos-amazon-v1.0.0-beta.21 (APK), uploaded by hand to Amazon; the third-party source bundle is kept on the Windows runner. Steps: docs/qualification/fire-os-live-app-testing-beta.21.md.

Qualification and limits

  • First end-to-end run of the release factory on the self-hosted runners: webOS and Fire OS jobs are new and have not run before this tag.
  • The webOS IPK is the sideload package; LG Content Store submission stays manual.
